integrations.value: See source-backed advertised interface/integration excerpt. Actual operation untested.

proprietary_access.unknown_reason: Inspected available public descriptions. No proprietary training corpus, exclusive provider rights, patented advantage, or unique customer data access independently established. Private contracts and model internals were not accessed.

switching_costs.unknown_reason: No measured migration effort, retention, expansion, or customer lock-in. Hypothesis only.

operating_economics.unknown_reason: No billed inference, infrastructure allocation, gross margin, customer-acquisition cost, or churn data observed. Vendor subscription prices do not establish cost of delivery or business value.

conflicts.finding: Different advertised lower bounds can both be true. Do not treat them as a proven contradiction or one audited integration count.
